stem: Harsh reads a ghee tin labelled "pure." The ingredients list ghee and a small amount of another substance mixed in.

parts.text: Which claim matches the scientific meaning of pure?

options.text: The contents are not a pure substance because more than one substance is present.
The contents are a pure substance because the tin is labelled pure.
The contents are a pure substance because the ghee looks the same throughout.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: In science a pure substance has no other substance present; another substance mixed in means the contents are a mixture.

teacher.key_rationale: A consumer 'pure' label does not make a mixture scientifically pure. More than one substance present means it is not a pure substance.
